root_cause: The Returns Centre page redirects to the sign‑in page (https://www.amazon.in/ap/signin) and requires the user to authenticate before the exchange request form can be displayed, preventing the agent from reaching the request_page_reached milestone.
fix:
Provide unauthenticated access to the exchange request form or add a clear "Continue as Guest" button on the sign‑in page. Example HTML snippet: ```html
Continue as Guest ``` Alternatively, expose the request page via a public URL and only require login after the user submits the request.
